in_marathi.name: Vyshnavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dweller in Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vyshnavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vyshnavi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishnu', meaning 'preserver of the universe'. The name Vyshnavi is a tribute to the God Vishnu and signifies one who dwells in His divine presence. This name is believed to bring protection, happiness, and prosperity.
